description: This visual allows you to quickly identify possible relationships and similarity in your semantic model data, without having to resort to using R or Python: it's largely drag-drop-and-click! It uses an algorithm based on "Partition Around Medoid" (PAM), with extensions allowing one to weight features independently and search for parameters that yield more effective clustering. This is considered an example of unsupervised machine learning. It has extensions that support: Circle packing (including zooming), or tabular layout styles; the circles / bubble style is often very good to visualize clusters Option exists to "disable clustering" which turns the visual into a pure circle pack display Can "search" text in data points, highlighting matches Coloring settings, including coloring like values, highlighting medoids, etc. Control over cluster naming Export results to the clipboard for easy import into Excel Ability to weight features automatically or manually "Solution finder" - lets you explore different settings to find "better" solutions Cross-filtering and drill through support The sample pbix file that can be downloaded here and on bizintelligencechampions.com provides a detailed look at how you can use this visual; we highly encourage reviewing it since it can answer many questions (along with the video below). The visual is free to use in Power BI Desktop for one user.…
